_comment: Open-data and imagery sources used beside OpenStreetMap for this venue. Referenced by overrides, merge, and trace files; replayed on every rebuild via the recipe.

sources.used_for: Park geometry, named water slides, pools, paths, buildings, and the venue boundary.
Ride and amenity positions where OSM names a geometry type but not the attraction, cross-checked against OSM slide and pool centroids.
Food, restroom, and river labels on the illustrated map; disambiguation of lookalike pools and flumes when paired with orthophoto positions.
Height requirements and attraction names for the 2026 season.
